units.source_text: 然而第三盘告别赛，由于名人生病中断，有人风传名人好像有什么企图。

en.t: However, the third farewell game was suspended because the Master fell ill, and rumors spread that he seemed to have some hidden intention.

units.source_text: 我自始至终都在旁观战，听到这些传闻，感到愕然。

en.t: I had been watching from the sidelines from beginning to end, and when I heard these rumors, I was stunned.
